title: Sutra-khanda, part 2 (portion 02)
html:
The end of the "sutra": a list of the pastimes of the Adi- and Madhya-khanda; praise of Chaitanya, Nityananda and Advaita; the narrative begins — Damodara's question about the reasons for Gauranga's appearance, Murari's answer on the decline of dharma in Kali, and Narada's grief

মায়ে আজ্ঞা দিলা একাদশী করিবারে ।
অনেক প্রকাশ-কথা কহিব সে কালে ॥ ৮২ ॥

māẏe ājñā dilā ekādaśī karibāre |
aneka prakāśa-kathā kahiba se kāle || 82 ||

maye ajna dila — He bade His mother; ekadashi karibare — to keep Ekadashi; aneka prakasha-katha — many accounts of revelation; kahiba se kale — I shall tell at that time

82how He bade His mother keep Ekadashi —
of His many revelations I shall tell in due time;

হেনই সময়ে জগন্নাথ পরলোক ।
কান্দয়ে যেমতে প্রভু পাঞা পিতৃশোক ॥ ৮৩ ॥

henai samaẏe jagannātha paraloka |
kāndaẏe yemate prabhu pāñā pitṛśoka || 83 ||

henai samaye — at that time; jagannatha paraloka — Jagannatha [went to] the other world; kandaye yemate — how He wept; prabhu — the Lord; pana pitri-shoka — grieving for His father

83how at that time Jagannatha [Mishra] passed to the other world,
and how the Lord wept, grieving for His father.

তবে ত কহিব কথা অপরূপ আর ।
বিবাহ করিলা প্রভু আনন্দ অপার ॥ ৮৪ ॥

tabe ta kahiba kathā aparūpa āra |
bibāha karilā prabhu ānanda apāra || 84 ||

tabe ta kahiba — then I shall tell; katha aparupa ara — another wondrous tale; vivaha karila prabhu — the Lord married; ananda apara — boundless joy

84Then I shall tell another wondrous tale:
the Lord married — joy without bounds;

গঙ্গা-সন্দর্শনে আর যে হৈল রহস্য ।
সাবধানে শুন ইহা কহিব অবশ্য ॥ ৮৫ ॥

gaṅgā-sandarśane āra ye haila rahasya |
sābadhāne śuna ihā kahiba abaśya || 85 ||

ganga-sandarshane — on seeing the Ganga; ara ye haila rahasya — and the secret that came about; savadhane shuna iha — listen to it attentively; kahiba avashya — I shall surely tell

85and the secret that came about when He saw the Ganga1 —
listen attentively, I shall surely tell it;

পূর্বদেশ-গমন কহিব ভালমতে ।
লক্ষ্মী-স্বর্গ-আরোহণ হৈল যেনমতে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

pūrbadeśa-gamana kahiba bhālamate |
lakṣmī-sbarga-ārohaṇa haila yenamate || 86 ||

purvadesha-gamana — the journey to the Eastern land (Bengal); kahiba bhalamate — I shall tell well; lakshmi-svarga-arohana — Lakshmi's ascent to heaven; haila yenamate — how it happened

86I shall tell well of the journey to East Bengal
and of how Lakshmi ascended to heaven;

দেশেরে আসিয়া পুন বিবাহ করিলা ।
শিষ্যে বিদ্যাদান দিয়া গয়ারে চলিলা ॥ ৮৭ ॥

deśere āsiẏā puna bibāha karilā |
śiṣye bidyādāna diẏā gaẏāre calilā || 87 ||

deshere asiya — coming back to His land; puna vivaha karila — married again; shishye vidyadana diya — giving knowledge to disciples; gayare chalila — went to Gaya

87returning to His own land He married again,
imparted knowledge to His disciples and set out for Gaya.

প্রত্যেকে কহিব কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
অনেক আনন্দ পাবে না ছাড় যতন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

pratyeke kahiba kathā śuna sarbajana |
aneka ānanda pābe nā chāṛa yatana || 88 ||

pratyeke kahiba katha — I shall tell of each; shuna sarvajana — listen, everyone; aneka ananda pabe — you will find great joy; na chhada yatana — do not give up effort

88Of each I shall tell — listen, all of you:
you will find great joy; do not give up your effort.

দেশ-আগমন-কথা কহিব বিশেষ ।
প্রেম প্রকাশয়ে নিরন্তর রসাবেশ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

deśa-āgamana-kathā kahiba biśeṣa |
prema prakāśaẏe nirantara rasābeśa || 89 ||

desha-agamana-katha — the tale of the return home; kahiba vishesha — I shall tell especially; prema prakashaye — He manifests prema; nirantara — unceasingly; rasavesha — absorbed in rasa

89Especially I shall tell of the return home:
He constantly manifests prema, absorbed in rasa.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা ভাই অনেক আনন্দ ।
শুনিতে পুলক বান্ধে অমিয়া অখণ্ড ॥ ৯০ ॥

madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā bhāi aneka ānanda |
śunite pulaka bāndhe amiẏā akhaṇḍa || 90 ||

madhyakhanda-katha — the tale of the Madhya-khanda; bhai — brothers; aneka ananda — great joy; shunite — on hearing; pulaka bandhe — hair stands on end; amiya akhanda — unbroken nectar

90The tale of the Madhya-khanda, brothers, is a great joy:
hearing it the hair stands on end — nectar without end.

ভক্ত-সন্দর্শন-কথা প্রেমার প্রকাশ ।
কহিবার আগে উঠে হৃদয়ে উল্লাস ॥ ৯১ ॥

bhakta-sandarśana-kathā premāra prakāśa |
kahibāra āge uṭhe hṛdaẏe ullāsa || 91 ||

bhakta-sandarshana-katha — the tale of meeting the devotees; premara prakasha — manifestation of prema; kahibara age — before the telling; uthe hridaye ullasa — joy rises in the heart

91The tale of the meeting with the devotees is the manifestation of prema:
even before I begin to tell it, my heart rejoices.

মধ্যখণ্ড-কথা ভাই নদীয়া-বিহার ।
অমিয়ার ধারা যেন প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ৯২ ॥

madhyakhaṇḍa-kathā bhāi nadīẏā-bihāra |
amiẏāra dhārā yena premāra pracāra || 92 ||

madhyakhanda-katha bhai — the tale of the Madhya-khanda, brothers; nadiya-vihara — the play in Nadia; amiyara dhara yena — like a stream of nectar; premara prachara — the spreading of prema

92The tale of the Madhya-khanda, brothers, is the play in Nadia:
like a stream of nectar — so prema was spread.

অতি অপরূপ লীলা প্রকাশিলা প্রভু ।
চারি যুগে ভক্ত যাহা নাহি শুনে কভু ॥ ৯৩ ॥

ati aparūpa līlā prakāśilā prabhu |
cāri yuge bhakta yāhā nāhi śune kabhu || 93 ||

ati aparupa lila — most unprecedented pastimes; prakashila prabhu — the Lord revealed; chari yuge — in the four yugas; bhakta yaha nahi shune kabhu — which devotees never heard

93The Lord revealed most unprecedented pastimes,
such as devotees never heard of in any of the four yugas.

হেন অদ্ভুত কথা ভক্তি-পরচার ।
কহিব সে মধ্যখণ্ডে নদীয়া-বিহার ॥ ৯৪ ॥

hena adbhuta kathā bhakti-paracāra |
kahiba se madhyakhaṇḍe nadīẏā-bihāra || 94 ||

hena adbhuta katha — this wondrous tale; bhakti-parachara — the spreading of bhakti; kahiba se madhyakhande — I shall tell in the Madhya-khanda; nadiya-vihara — the play in Nadia

94This wondrous tale, the spreading of bhakti,
I shall tell in the Madhya-khanda — the play in Nadia.

সকল ভকত মেলি হইল যেনমতে ।
প্রত্যেকে কহিব ইহা যে জানি কহিতে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

sakala bhakata meli haila yenamate |
pratyeke kahiba ihā ye jāni kahite || 95 ||

sakala bhakata meli — all the devotees together; haila yenamate — how they gathered; pratyeke kahiba iha — I shall tell of each; ye jani kahite — as far as I know how to tell

95How all the devotees came together —
of each I shall tell, as far as I know how to tell.

প্রথমে কহিব শচী পাইল প্রেমদান ।
পথেতে যেমতে শুনে বংশীর নিস্বান ॥ ৯৬ ॥

prathame kahiba śacī pāila premadāna |
pathete yemate śune baṃśīra nisbāna || 96 ||

prathame kahiba — first I shall tell; shachi paila premadana — [how] Shachi received the gift of prema; pathete yemate shune — how on the road He heard; vamshira nisvana — the sound of the flute

96First I shall tell how Shachi received the gift of prema,
how on the road He heard the sound of the flute,

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল হৈলা ভাবের আবেশে ।
আচম্বিতে দেববাণী উঠিল আকাশে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

premāẏa bihbala hailā bhābera ābeśe |
ācambite debabāṇī uṭhila ākāśe || 97 ||

premaya vihvala haila — He was overwhelmed with prema; bhavera aveshe — seized by bhava; achambite — suddenly; devavani uthila akashe — a heavenly voice arose in the sky

97how, seized by bhava, He was overwhelmed with prema,
and suddenly a voice from heaven sounded in the sky;

মুরারিরে কৃপা কৈলা বরাহ-আবেশে ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি দেব দেখে আপন-আবেশে ॥ ৯৮ ॥

murārire kṛpā kailā barāha-ābeśe |
brahmā-ādi deba dekhe āpana-ābeśe || 98 ||

murarire kripa kaila — He showed mercy to Murari; varaha-aveshe — absorbed as Varaha; brahma-adi deva — Brahma and the other gods; dekhe — behold; apana-aveshe — themselves enraptured

98how in the form of Varaha He showed mercy to Murari;
Brahma and the other gods behold [it], themselves enraptured;

শুক্লাম্বর ব্রহ্মচারী প্রেম পাইল তবে ।
কহিব সকল কথা শুন সর্বভাবে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

śuklāmbara brahmacārī prema pāila tabe |
kahiba sakala kathā śuna sarbabhābe || 99 ||

shuklambara brahmachari — Shuklambara Brahmachari; prema paila tabe — then obtained prema; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell it all; shuna sarvabhave — listen with all your heart

99how Shuklambara Brahmachari then obtained prema —
I shall tell it all, listen with all your heart;

পণ্ডিত শ্রীগদাধর প্রভুর পরাণ ।
প্রেমায় বিভোর হঞা দিবানিশি কান্দে ॥ ১০০ ॥

paṇḍita śrīgadādhara prabhura parāṇa |
premāẏa bibhora hañā dibāniśi kānde || 100 ||

pandita sri-gadadhara — Pandita Sri Gadadhara; prabhura parana — the Lord's life; premaya vibhora haina — overwhelmed with prema; diva-nishi kande — weeps day and night

100Pandita Sri Gadadhara, [dear to] the Lord as life,2
overwhelmed with prema, weeps day and night;

একে একে দিল সর্বজনে প্রেমদান ।
কহিব সকল কথা যেমন বিধান ॥ ১০১ ॥

eke eke dila sarbajane premadāna |
kahiba sakala kathā yemana bidhāna || 101 ||

eke eke — one by one; dila sarvajane premadana — He gave prema to all; kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell it all; yemana vidhana — as is fitting

101one by one He gave prema to all —
I shall tell it all as is fitting;

ভক্তকে প্রসাদ আম্রবীজ-আরোপণে ।
যা শুনিলে সর্বজনের দ্বিধা ঘুচে মনে ॥ ১০২ ॥

bhaktake prasāda āmrabīja-āropaṇe |
yā śunile sarbajanera dbidhā ghuce mane || 102 ||

bhaktake prasada — mercy to a devotee; amra-bija-aropane — by planting a mango stone; ya shunile — hearing which; sarvajanera dvidha ghuche mane — everyone's doubts vanish from the mind

102His mercy to a devotee — how He planted a mango stone:
hearing of it, all will be freed from doubt;

অধ্যাত্ম আচ্ছাদি প্রভু প্রেম প্রকাশয় ।
জ্ঞানগম্য নহে প্রভু সভারে বুঝায় ॥ ১০৩ ॥

adhyātma ācchādi prabhu prema prakāśaẏa |
jñānagamya nahe prabhu sabhāre bujhāẏa || 103 ||

adhyatma achchhadi — eclipsing the doctrine of the Self; prabhu prema prakashaya — the Lord reveals prema; jnana-gamya nahe — not reached by knowledge; prabhu sabhare bujhaya — the Lord explains to all

103the Lord, eclipsing the doctrine of the Self (adhyatma), reveals prema:
He is not reached by knowledge — so He explains to all.

তবে ত কহিব কথা অপূর্বকথন ।
যেমতে হইল নিত্যানন্দ-সন্দর্শন ॥ ১০৪ ॥

tabe ta kahiba kathā apūrbakathana |
yemate haila nityānanda-sandarśana || 104 ||

tabe ta kahiba katha — then I shall tell; apurva-kathana — an unprecedented account; yemate haila — how there came about; nityananda-sandarshana — the meeting with Nityananda

104Then I shall tell an unprecedented account —
how the meeting with Nityananda came about,

হরিদাস প্রভু-সনে মিলয়ে যেমনে ।
অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-নিত্যানন্দের মিলনে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

haridāsa prabhu-sane milaẏe yemane |
adbaita-ācārya-nityānandera milane || 105 ||

haridasa prabhu-sane milaye yemane — how Haridasa meets the Lord; advaita-acharya-nityanandera milane — of the meeting of Advaita Acharya and Nityananda

105how Haridasa meets the Lord,
of the meeting of Advaita Acharya with Nityananda,

যেনমতে জগাই-মাধাই নিস্তারিলা ।
পিতা-পুত্র ব্রাহ্মণেরে যেন কৃপা কৈলা ॥ ১০৬ ॥

yenamate jagāi-mādhāi nistārilā |
pitā-putra brāhmaṇere yena kṛpā kailā || 106 ||

yenamate — how; jagai-madhai nistarila — He delivered Jagai and Madhai; pita-putra brahmanere — to the father and son, brahmanas; yena kripa kaila — how He showed mercy

106how He delivered Jagai and Madhai,
how He showed mercy to a father and son, brahmanas,

শিবের গায়নে কৃপা কৈলা যেনমতে ।
আচম্বিতে খেদ উঠে ব্রাহ্মণ-চরিতে ॥ ১০৭ ॥

śibera gāẏane kṛpā kailā yenamate |
ācambite kheda uṭhe brāhmaṇa-carite || 107 ||

shivera gayane — to the singer of Shiva; kripa kaila yenamate — how He showed mercy; achambite — suddenly; kheda uthe — grief arises; brahmana-charite — from a brahmana's deed

107how He showed mercy to a singer [of songs] of Shiva;
how suddenly grief arose from a brahmana's deed,3

যেনমতে জাহ্নবীতে দিলা প্রভু ঝাঁপ ।
যা শুনিলে তিনলোকে উঠে হিয়া-কাঁপ ॥ ১০৮ ॥

yenamate jāhnabīte dilā prabhu jhāṁpa |
yā śunile tinaloke uṭhe hiẏā-kāṁpa || 108 ||

yenamate — how; jahnavite dila prabhu jhanpa — the Lord leapt into the Jahnavi; ya shunile — hearing which; tina-loke — in the three worlds; uthe hiya-kanpa — hearts tremble

108how the Lord threw Himself into the Jahnavi —
hearing of it, hearts will tremble in the three worlds;

তবে আর অপরূপ শুনিবে বিধানে ।
দেবালয় মার্জনা প্রভু করিলা যেমনে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

tabe āra aparūpa śunibe bidhāne |
debālaẏa mārjanā prabhu karilā yemane || 109 ||

tabe ara aparupa — then another wonder; shunibe vidhane — you will hear in order; devalaya marjana — the cleansing of the temple; prabhu karila yemane — how the Lord did it

109then you will hear in due order another wonder —
how the Lord cleansed the temple;

শুনিবে অনেক কথা অতি অপরূপ ।
কুষ্ঠব্যাধি নিস্তারিলা এ বড় কৌতুক ॥ ১১০ ॥

śunibe aneka kathā ati aparūpa |
kuṣṭhabyādhi nistārilā e baṛa kautuka || 110 ||

shunibe aneka katha — you will hear much; ati aparupa — most unprecedented; kushtha-vyadhi nistarila — He delivered a leper; e bada kautuka — this is a great marvel

110you will hear many quite unprecedented things:
He delivered a leper — a great marvel;

বলরাম-আবেশ-কথা কহিব বিশেষ ।
যা শুনিলে সভে পাবে আনন্দ অশেষ ॥ ১১১ ॥

balarāma-ābeśa-kathā kahiba biśeṣa |
yā śunile sabhe pābe ānanda aśeṣa || 111 ||

balarama-avesha-katha — the tale of how the bhava of Balarama took hold [of Him]; kahiba vishesha — I shall tell especially; ya shunile — hearing which; sabhe pabe ananda ashesha — all will find endless joy

111especially I shall tell how the bhava of Balarama took hold of Him —
hearing of it, all will find joy without end;

শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্যের বাড়ীতে প্রকাশ ।
প্রেম-পরকাশে ছায় এ ভূমি আকাশ ॥ ১১২ ॥

śrīcandraśekharācāryera bāṛīte prakāśa |
prema-parakāśe chāẏa e bhūmi ākāśa || 112 ||

sri-chandrashekharacharyera badite — in the house of Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya; prakasha — revelation; prema-parakashe — with the radiance of prema; chhaya — are covered; e bhumi akasha — this earth and sky

112the revelation in the house of Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya:
the radiance of prema floods earth and sky;

অনেক রহস্য কথা কহিব তাহাতে ।
বৈরাগ্য অদ্ভুত প্রভুর উঠে যেনমতে ॥ ১১৩ ॥

aneka rahasya kathā kahiba tāhāte |
bairāgya adbhuta prabhura uṭhe yenamate || 113 ||

aneka rahasya katha — many secret matters; kahiba tahate — I shall tell therein; vairagya adbhuta — wondrous renunciation; prabhura uthe yenamate — how it arose in the Lord

113many secrets I shall tell there —
how wondrous renunciation awoke in the Lord,

শ্রীকেশবভারতী দেখি নদীয়া-নগরে ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব বলি উল্লাস অন্তরে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

śrīkeśababhāratī dekhi nadīẏā-nagare |
sannyāsa kariba bali ullāsa antare || 114 ||

sri-keshava-bharati dekhi — seeing Sri Keshava Bharati; nadiya-nagare — in the town of Nadia; sannyasa kariba bali — saying "I will take sannyasa"; ullasa antare — joy in the heart

114how, seeing Keshava Bharati in the town of Nadia,
He rejoices at heart: "I will take sannyasa!";

যেনমতে সর্বভক্তগণের বিলাপ ।
শচী-বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া শোকসাগরে দিল ঝাঁপ ॥ ১১৫ ॥

yenamate sarbabhaktagaṇera bilāpa |
śacī-biṣṇupriẏā śokasāgare dila jhāṁpa || 115 ||

how He went to the house of Acharya Prabhu,4

জগন্নাথ-সন্দর্শন হৈল যেনমতে ।

Grantharambha (The Narrative Begins)

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. At the beginning of the narrative the author, relying on the conversation of Narada and Uddhava from the Jaimini-bharata, which is related in the dialogue of Damodara and Murari, has set down the reason why Krishna descended in the form of Gaura. Once the devarshi Narada, grieved by the sufferings of the living beings stricken by Kali and pondering how to save them, resolved to move the protector of dharma, Bhagavan Sri Krishna, to descend into the mortal world, and set out for Dvaraka. Sri Krishna was then staying in the palace of Rukmini-devi. Rukmini-devi, having learned that Krishna, accepting the bhava of Radha, would descend in the form of Gaura, was in the greatest distress at the thought of the coming separation; she was glorifying His lotus feet and confiding her grief to Him when the devarshi Narada arrived. Received by Krishna with honour, he told the reason for his coming, and Krishna revealed to him that He would descend in the form of Gaura in the house of Shachi and Jagannatha at Navadvipa, and at once showed him His form as Gaura. Seeing the supremely lovely form of Gaura, the devarshi Narada, beside himself with rapture, went on from there meditating on the form of Gaura and singing the glory of Gaura, the essence of all avataras, and came to Naimisharanya. There the best of devotees, Uddhava, asked the great sage how the living beings stricken by Kali could be saved; the devarshi Narada told him all that had happened, sang the glory of the Kali-yuga, the essence of all yugas, and of the dharma of that age, the sankirtana of Hari-nama, and came to Kailasa, to the best of Vaishnavas, Shambhu. There Narada, wishing to remind Parvati of her former vow, [related]: how, learning of the greatness of mahaprasada, he served Lakshmi for twelve years to obtain it, and by her grace obtained mahaprasada and gave a portion to Shiva; how Shiva, having tasted the mahaprasada, broke into a wild dance; how the Earth, unable to bear Shiva's dance, came to Parvati; and then the greatness of mahaprasada and Parvati's vow to distribute mahaprasada to all living beings; and he sang much of the descent of Gaura. Then Narada came to Brahma and told of Gaurasundara's descent in the Kali-yuga. Brahma quoted and explained to Narada the verses of the Srimad-Bhagavata concerning this descent, supported the sense of these verses of the Bhagavata with the words of other scriptures, and said that at the time of Gaura's descent he himself would appear on earth with all the gods. Next comes the proposal of the gods to take birth in the mortal world; [the account of how] Krishna, accepting the bhava and lustre of Srimati Radhika, together with the special qualities of His eternal consorts Rukmini, Satyabhama and others, taking up the weapon of the sankirtana of the Name, descends as Gaura, Balarama as Nityananda, Shiva as Advaita Prabhu, and the other associates as Murari, Mukunda, Srinivasa, Raya Ramananda, Ishvara Puri, Madhava Puri; having described this, the author sang the glory of his guru Thakura Narahari and of his nephew Raghunandana and concluded the Sutra-khanda.7

jaẏa jaẏa adbaita-ācārya sukhānanda || 1 ||

glory, glory to Advaita Acharya, full of bliss!

গদাধর-প্রাণ জয় জয় নরহরি ।
জয় জয় শ্রীনিবাস ভক্তি-অধিকারী ॥ ২ ॥

gadādhara-prāṇa jaẏa jaẏa narahari |
jaẏa jaẏa śrīnibāsa bhakti-adhikārī || 2 ||

gadadhara-prana — the life of Gadadhara; jaya jaya narahari — glory, glory to Narahari; shrinivasa — to Srinivasa; bhakti-adhikari — worthy of bhakti

2Glory, glory to Narahari, [dear as] life to Gadadhara,9
glory, glory to Srinivasa, worthy of bhakti!

চৈতন্য-গোসাঞির যত প্রিয় ভক্তগণ ।
সভার চরণ হৃদে করিয়ে বন্দন ॥ ৩ ॥

caitanya-gosāñira yata priẏa bhaktagaṇa |
sabhāra caraṇa hṛde kariẏe bandana || 3 ||

chaitanya-gosanira — of Chaitanya Gosani; yata priya bhakta-gana — all the beloved devotees; sabhara charana — the feet of all; hride — in the heart; kariye bandana — I praise

3All the beloved devotees of Chaitanya Gosani —
the feet of them all, [holding them] in my heart, I praise.

কহিব চৈতন্যকথা শুন সাবধানে ।
দামোদর-পণ্ডিত পুছিলা গুপ্ত-স্থানে ॥ ৪ ॥

kahiba caitanyakathā śuna sābadhāne |
dāmodara-paṇḍita puchilā gupta-sthāne || 4 ||

kahiba chaitanya-katha — I shall tell of Chaitanya; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; damodara-pandita — Damodara Pandita; puchhila gupta-sthane — asked of Gupta

4I shall tell of Chaitanya — listen attentively:
Damodara Pandita asked Gupta:10

কহ শুনি কি লাগি গৌরাঙ্গ-অবতার ।
শুনিতে আনন্দ মনে হইছে আমার ॥ ৫ ॥

kaha śuni ki lāgi gaurāṅga-abatāra |
śunite ānanda mane haiche āmāra || 5 ||

kaha shuni — tell, I shall hear; ki lagi — for what reason; gauranga-avatara — the descent of Gauranga; shunite — in hearing; ananda mane haichhe amara — joy arises in my heart

5"Tell me, and I shall listen: for what reason did Gauranga appear?
To hear of it is a joy to my heart.

কেনে শ্যামবর্ণ ত্যজি হৈলা গৌরতনু ।
কেনে বা কীর্তনে লুটি গায় মাখে রেণু ॥ ৬ ॥

kene śyāmabarṇa tyaji hailā gauratanu |
kene bā kīrtane luṭi gāẏa mākhe reṇu || 6 ||

kene — why; shyama-varna tyaji — leaving the dark colour; haila gaura-tanu — became golden of body; kene ba — why; kirtane luti — rolling in kirtana; gaya makhe renu — smears dust on His body

6Why did He leave His dark colour and become Gaura?
Why in kirtana does He roll on the ground and cover His body with dust?

কেনে বা নাগর-বেশ ছাড়িয়া সন্ন্যাস ।
কেনে দেশে দেশে বুলে হইয়া হতাশ ॥ ৭ ॥

kene bā nāgara-beśa chāṛiẏā sannyāsa |
kene deśe deśe bule haiẏā hatāśa || 7 ||

kene ba — why; nagara-vesha chhadiya — leaving the nagara's dress; sannyasa — sannyasa; kene deshe deshe bule — why He wanders land to land; haiya hatasha — as if in despair

7Why did He exchange the dress of a nagara11 for sannyasa?
Why does He wander from land to land as though in despair?

কেনে কান্দে রাধা রাধা গোবিন্দ বলিয়া ।
ঘরে ঘরে বুলে কেনে প্রেম যাচাইয়া ॥ ৮ ॥

kene kānde rādhā rādhā gobinda baliẏā |
ghare ghare bule kene prema yācāiẏā || 8 ||

kene kande — why He weeps; radha radha govinda baliya — calling "Radha, Radha, Govinda"; ghare ghare bule kene — why He goes from house to house; prema yachaiya — offering prema

8Why does He weep, calling out, 'Radha! Radha! Govinda!'?
Why does He go from house to house offering prema?

কহিবে সকল কথা পরম নিগূঢ় ।
যা শুনিলে ত্রাণ পায় অখিলের মূঢ় ॥ ৯ ॥

kahibe sakala kathā parama nigūṛha |
yā śunile trāṇa pāẏa akhilera mūṛha || 9 ||

kahibe — please tell; sakala katha — all this; parama nigudha — the deepest secret; ya shunile — hearing which; trana paya — are saved; akhilera mudha — the most foolish of all

9Tell me all this — the deepest secret,
hearing which even the most foolish of fools are saved."

শুনিয়া মুরারি কহে শুনহ পণ্ডিত ।
এই সব তত্ত্ব তোমা করিব বিদিত ॥ ১০ ॥

śuniẏā murāri kahe śunaha paṇḍita |
ei saba tattba tomā kariba bidita || 10 ||

shuniya — having heard; murari kahe — Murari says; shunaha pandita — listen, Pandita; ei saba tattva — all this truth; toma kariba vidita — I shall make known to you

10Having heard, Murari says: "Listen, Pandita;
all this truth I will reveal to you.

সত্যযুগে চারি অংশ ধর্ম শাস্ত্রে কহে ।
ত্রেতাতে ত্রিভাগ ধর্ম কহিয়ে তোমারে ॥ ১১ ॥

satyayuge cāri aṃśa dharma śāstre kahe |
tretāte tribhāga dharma kahiẏe tomāre || 11 ||

satya-yuge — in the Satya-yuga; chari amsha dharma — four quarters of dharma; shastre kahe — the shastras say; tretate — in the Treta; tribhaga dharma — three quarters of dharma; kahiye tomare — I tell you

11In the Satya-yuga dharma has four quarters — so say the shastras;
in the Treta-yuga, I tell you, dharma has three quarters;

দ্বাপরে অর্ধেক ধর্ম কহিয়ে তোমারে ।
কলিযুগে এক অংশ ধর্মের বিচারে ॥ ১২ ॥

dbāpare ardheka dharma kahiẏe tomāre |
kaliyuge eka aṃśa dharmera bicāre || 12 ||

dvapare — in the Dvapara; ardheka dharma — half of dharma; kahiye tomare — I tell you; kali-yuge eka amsha — in the Kali-yuga one quarter; dharmera vichare — by the reckoning of dharma

12in the Dvapara-yuga, I tell you, dharma is half;
in the Kali-yuga, by the reckoning of dharma, one quarter.

অধর্ম বাড়িল ধর্ম হইল যে ক্ষীণ ।
স্বধর্ম ছাড়িল বর্ণ-আশ্রম-বিহীন ॥ ১৩ ॥

adharma bāṛila dharma haila ye kṣīṇa |
sbadharma chāṛila barṇa-āśrama-bihīna || 13 ||

adharma badila — adharma grew; dharma haila ye kshina — dharma became weak; svadharma chhadila — they abandoned their duty; varna-ashrama-vihina — without varnas and ashramas

13Adharma grew, dharma dwindled;
[people] abandoned their own duty; there are neither varnas nor ashramas.

পাপময় ঘোর আন্ধিয়ার হৈল কলি ।
মজিল সকল লোক অধর্ম-বিকলি ॥ ১৪ ॥

pāpamaẏa ghora āndhiẏāra haila kali |
majila sakala loka adharma-bikali || 14 ||

papamaya — sinful; ghora andhiyara — dense darkness; haila kali — Kali became; majila sakala loka — all people sank; adharma-vikali — crippled by adharma

14Kali became a sinful, impenetrable darkness;
all people sank, crippled by adharma.

ধর্মহীন দেখিয়া নারদ মহামুনি ।
কলি তরিবারে দয়া করিলা আপনি ॥ ১৫ ॥

dharmahīna dekhiẏā nārada mahāmuni |
kali taribāre daẏā karilā āpani || 15 ||

dharma-hina dekhiya — seeing [the world] without dharma; narada mahamuni — the great sage Narada; kali taribare — to deliver Kali; daya karila apani — himself showed compassion

15Seeing that there was no dharma, the great sage Narada
was himself moved to compassion, [wishing] to save [the people of] Kali.

ভাবিলেন কলিসর্প গিলিল সভারে ।
মনে হৈল ধর্ম সংস্থাপন করিবারে ॥ ১৬ ॥

bhābilena kalisarpa gilila sabhāre |
mane haila dharma saṃsthāpana karibāre || 16 ||

bhavilena — he thought; kali-sarpa gilila sabhare — the serpent Kali has swallowed all; mane haila — it came to his mind; dharma samsthapana karibare — to establish dharma

16He thought: 'The serpent Kali has swallowed everyone,'
and he wished to establish dharma:

কৃষ্ণ বিনু ধর্ম কেহো না পারে স্থাপিতে ।
অবশ্য আনিব কৃষ্ণ কলিতে ত্বরিতে ॥ ১৭ ॥

kṛṣṇa binu dharma keho nā pāre sthāpite |
abaśya āniba kṛṣṇa kalite tbarite || 17 ||

krishna vinu — without Krishna; dharma keho na pare sthapite — no one can establish dharma; avashya aniba krishna — I shall surely bring Krishna; kalite tvarite — into Kali quickly

17'Without Krishna no one can establish dharma;
I shall surely bring Krishna into Kali, and quickly.

ভক্ত-ইচ্ছা গোবিন্দের হয় সর্বকাল ।
বেদাগমশাস্ত্রে ইহা আছয়ে বিচার ॥ ১৮ ॥

bhakta-icchā gobindera haẏa sarbakāla |
bedāgamaśāstre ihā āchaẏe bicāra || 18 ||

bhakta-ichchha — the devotee's wish; govindera haya sarvakala — is always Govinda's; vedagama-shastre — in the Vedas, agamas and shastras; iha achhaye vichara — this is the conclusion

18The devotee's wish is ever Govinda's wish:
such is the conclusion of the Vedas, agamas and shastras.

যদি কৃষ্ণদাস মুঞি হঙ সর্বথায় ।
কলিতে আনিব তবে প্রভু যদুরায় ॥ ১৯ ॥

yadi kṛṣṇadāsa muñi haṅa sarbathāẏa |
kalite āniba tabe prabhu yadurāẏa || 19 ||

yadi — if; krishna-dasa muni hau — I am Krishna's servant; sarvathaya — in every way; kalite aniba tabe — then I shall bring into Kali; prabhu yaduraya — the Lord, king of the Yadus

19If I am in every way a servant of Krishna,
I shall bring into Kali the Lord, the king of the Yadus.

দেখোঁ আগে কলিযুগ করে কোন্ কর্ম ।
তবে সে আনিব কৃষ্ণ সর্বময় ধর্ম ॥ ২০ ॥

dekhoṁ āge kaliyuga kare kon karma |
tabe se āniba kṛṣṇa sarbamaẏa dharma || 20 ||

dekho age — let me first see; kali-yuga kare kon karma — what deeds the Kali-yuga does; tabe se aniba krishna — then I shall bring Krishna; sarvamaya dharma — the all-embracing dharma

20Let me first see what the Kali-yuga does,
and then I shall bring Krishna, the all-embracing dharma.

আনিব সকল দেব তাঁহার সঙ্গে ।
অস্ত্র-পারিষদ-আদি সকল সাঙ্গোপাঙ্গে ॥ ২১ ॥

āniba sakala deba tāṁhāra saṅge |
astra-pāriṣada-ādi sakala sāṅgopāṅge || 21 ||

aniba sakala deva — I shall bring all the gods; tanhara sange — with Him; astra-parishada-adi — weapons, associates and others; sakala sangopange — all intimates and retinue

21I shall bring all the gods with Him —
His weapons, His associates, all His intimates and retinue.'

ব্রহ্মা আদি দেবগণ নারদাদি মুনি ।
পৃথিবীতে জনম লৈলা দেবী কাত্যায়নী ॥ ২২ ॥

brahmā ādi debagaṇa nāradādi muni |
pṛthibīte janama lailā debī kātyāẏanī || 22 ||

brahma adi deva-gana — Brahma and the other gods; naradadi muni — Narada and the other sages; prithivite janama laila — took birth on earth; devi katyayani — the goddess Katyayani

22Brahma and the other gods, Narada and the other sages,
the goddess Katyayani took birth on earth;12

দ্বারকায় আর যত ছিল যদুবংশে ।
পৃথিবীতে জনম লৈল নিজ নিজ অংশে ॥ ২৩ ॥

dbārakāẏa āra yata chila yadubaṃśe |
pṛthibīte janama laila nija nija aṃśe || 23 ||

dvarakaya — in Dvaraka; ara yata chhila yaduvamshe — and all who were of the Yadu line; prithivite janama laila — took birth on earth; nija nija amshe — each by his own portion

23all who were in Dvaraka, in the line of Yadu,
took birth on earth, each by his own portion.

কহিব সকল কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
পৃথিবীতে অবতার হইল যেমনে ॥ ২৪ ॥

kahiba sakala kathā śuna sābadhāne |
pṛthibīte abatāra haila yemane || 24 ||

kahiba sakala katha — I shall tell it all; shuna savadhane — listen attentively; prithivite avatara — the descent upon earth; haila yemane — how it came about

24I shall tell it all — listen attentively —
how the descent upon earth came about.

সব অবতার-সার গোরা-অবতার ।
এমন করুণা কভু নাহি হয় আর ॥ ২৫ ॥

saba abatāra-sāra gorā-abatāra |
emana karuṇā kabhu nāhi haẏa āra || 25 ||

saba avatara-sara — the essence of all descents; gora-avatara — the descent of Gora; emana karuna — such compassion; kabhu nahi haya ara — never was before

25The descent of Gora is the essence of all descents:
such compassion never was before.

পরদুঃখে দুঃখিত নারদ মহামুনি ।
কৃষ্ণকথা-রস-গান দিবস-রজনী ॥ ২৬ ॥

paraduḥkhe duḥkhita nārada mahāmuni |
kṛṣṇakathā-rasa-gāna dibasa-rajanī || 26 ||

para-duhkhe duhkhita — grieved by others' sorrow; narada mahamuni — the great sage Narada; krishna-katha-rasa-gana — singing the rasa of Krishna's tales; dibasa-rajani — day and night

26The great sage Narada, grieved by the sorrow of others,
sings day and night the rasa of the tales of Krishna.

কৃষ্ণকথা-লোভে বুলে সংসার ভ্রমিয়া ।
না শুনিল কৃষ্ণনাম সংসার চাহিয়া ॥ ২৭ ॥

kṛṣṇakathā-lobhe bule saṃsāra bhramiẏā |
nā śunila kṛṣṇanāma saṃsāra cāhiẏā || 27 ||

krishna-katha-lobhe — greedy for Krishna's tales; bule samsara bhramiya — he roams the whole world; na shunila krishna-nama — he did not hear Krishna's name; samsara chahiya — looking over the world

27Thirsting for tales of Krishna, he roams the whole world,
but, looking over the world, he did not hear the name of Krishna.

কৃষ্ণরসে গদগদ আধ আধ ভাষ ।
ক্ষণেক রোদন ক্ষণে অট্ট অট্ট হাস ॥ ২৮ ॥

kṛṣṇarase gadagada ādha ādha bhāṣa |
kṣaṇeka rodana kṣaṇe aṭṭa aṭṭa hāsa || 28 ||

krishna-rase gadagada — choking with Krishna's rasa; adha adha bhasha — half-words; kshaneka rodana — now weeping; kshane atta atta hasa — now loud laughter

28Choking with the rasa of Krishna, he babbles in half-words,
now weeping, now laughing aloud;

বীণা-সনে গুণ গায় ঝরে আঁখি-নীর ।
কৃষ্ণরসাবেশ মুনির অন্তর-বাহির ॥ ২৯ ॥

bīṇā-sane guṇa gāẏa jhare āṁkhi-nīra |
kṛṣṇarasābeśa munira antara-bāhira || 29 ||

vina-sane — with the vina; guna gaya — he sings the virtues; jhare ankhi-nira — tears stream from the eyes; krishna-rasavesha — absorption in Krishna's rasa; munira antara-bahira — the sage's inside and outside

29he sings [Krishna's] virtues to the vina, tears stream from his eyes:
within and without, the sage is absorbed in the rasa of Krishna.

এছন প্রেমার রঙ্গে অঙ্গ গড়াইয়া ।
না শুনিল কৃষ্ণনাম সংসার ঘুরিয়া ॥ ৩০ ॥

echana premāra raṅge aṅga gaṛāiẏā |
nā śunila kṛṣṇanāma saṃsāra ghuriẏā || 30 ||

echhana premara range — in such play of prema; anga gadaiya — rolling his body; na shunila krishna-nama — he did not hear Krishna's name; samsara ghuriya — going round the world

30In such play of prema, rolling on the ground,
he did not hear the name of Krishna, though he went round the world.

অন্তরে দুঃখিত মুনি বিস্মিত হিয়ায় ।
লোক-নিস্তারণ-হেতু না দেখি উপায় ॥ ৩১ ॥

antare duḥkhita muni bismita hiẏāẏa |
loka-nistāraṇa-hetu nā dekhi upāẏa || 31 ||

antare duhkhita muni — the sage pained at heart; vismita hiyaya — amazed in mind; loka-nistarana-hetu — for the deliverance of people; na dekhi upaya — sees no means

31Pained at heart, the sage was amazed:
he sees no way to save the people.

দংশিল সকল লোকে কলি-কালসর্পে ।
নিরন্তর দগধ মুগধ মায়া-দর্পে ॥ ৩২ ॥

daṃśila sakala loke kali-kālasarpe |
nirantara dagadha mugadha māẏā-darpe || 32 ||

damshila sakala loke — has bitten all people; kali-kalasarpe — the black serpent Kali; nirantara dagadha — ever burning; mugadha — bewildered; maya-darpe — by the pride of maya

32The black serpent Kali has bitten all people:
they burn unceasingly, blinded by the pride of maya.

✦

Notes

  1. The Adi-khanda tells of the goddess Ganga's love for the young Nimai (so in Bhaktisiddhanta's survey of the parts and in the 1983 edition).
  2. So in Bhaktisiddhanta's text (A: "prabhura prana"); the 1983 edition has "by the Lord's grace".
  3. In the Madhya-khanda — the curse a brahmana pronounced upon the Lord (see Bhaktisiddhanta's summary of that chapter).
  4. Advaita Acharya's, at Shantipur.
  5. Literally "The Madhya-khanda ends: in the book, the manifestation of prema." Contrary to expectation, nothing is said here of the contents of the Shesha-khanda: Lochana Dasa only promises to tell of it; the meeting with Sarvabhauma he still assigns to the Madhya-khanda.
  6. Mahesha is Shiva. According to the Gaura-ganoddesha-dipika and the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 6), Advaita Acharya is Maha-Vishnu, non-different from Hari, and at the same time Sadashiva; Lochana Dasa names here only the second aspect.
  7. The summary covers the whole section "Grantharambha" to the end of the Sutra-khanda (portions 02–08 of our translation). A few words are corrupt in the OCR and have been restored from the same summary in the Khanda-vivarana at the beginning of the edition.
  8. Nichhani is the rite in which one waves something around a beloved person to "take off" all harm and take it upon oneself; balai laya, "I take your ill upon myself", is an expression of tender love.
  9. So in Bhaktisiddhanta's text (A: "gadadhara-prana"); the 1983 edition has "Glory to Gadadhara Pandita, glory to Narahari".
  10. The 1983 edition has two couplets here instead of this one (a different redaction): "I shall tell of Chaitanya — listen attentively — how He descended in the age of Kali.
